name: 2C-B-3PIP-POMe
summary: 2C-B-3PIP-POMe is a serotonin receptor modulator of the phenethylamine, 2C, 3-phenylpiperidine (3PIP), and NBOMe families. It is a cyclized phenethylamine and along with 2C-B-3PIP-NBOMe is an NBOMe derivative of 2C-B-3PIP. The drug is a mixture of cis- and trans- isomers.

pharmacology.text: 2C-B-3PIP-POMe is a serotonin receptor modulator of the phenethylamine, 2C, 3-phenylpiperidine (3PIP), and NBOMe families.
